analysis.summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported a revenue of ₹110.7 crores and an EBITDA of ₹22.6 crores in FY26, representing significant growth over previous years. The company operates an ISO-certified manufacturing facility in Ahmedabad with an installed capacity of 22,000 MTPA, which achieved a capacity utilization of 52.7% in FY26. Management highlighted strategic initiatives to diversify product applications into home and personal care to reduce single-segment concentration risk. Additionally, the company is expanding its geographical footprint across international markets and advancing sustainable, bio-based alternatives to synthetic chemistries. Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported a 32% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 110.7 crores and a 53% increase in EBITDA to INR 22.6 crores for FY26.

guidance.claim: The company expects to benefit from stronger fixed cost absorption and operating leverage as capacity utilization levels continue to improve.
guidance.quote: As utilization levels continue to improve, we expect to benefit from stronger fixed cost absorption and operating leverage, supporting sustainable margin expansion over time.

guidance.claim: The company expects its finance costs to moderate further over time as the full benefits of de-leveraging flow through.
guidance.quote: As the full benefits of our de-leveraging efforts flow through, we expect finance cost to moderate further over time.

guidance.claim: The company aims to bring its trade receivables to around 120 days by H1 FY27 or by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: Having said that, we understand that it is again going a little out of line as compared to our previous numbers, and we aim to bring it to around 120 days, maybe by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates reaching around 65% capacity utilization by the end of the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: So the capacity utilization, as we have already achieved 26% volume growth last year, and we expect to grow on similar lines, broadly we anticipate that by the end of the current fiscal year, we should reach around 65% capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: The company targets to have 30% to 35% of its revenue coming from exports in the next three years.
guidance.quote: But it's an entire cycle, sir, that it's not only one country. Lot of things are interconnected. So we saw some hit there, but broadly we see that in next three years Neochem's target is that we should have 30-35% revenue coming from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong local demand and supportive policy are driving Indian firms to invest more in R&D and production capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong local demand and supportive policy are driving Indian firms to invest more in R&D and production capacity

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile chemicals market is experiencing a structural shift toward premium, sustainable, and higher-value manufacturing.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s textile chemicals market is riding a structural shift toward premium, sustainable, higher-value manufacturing.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in FY26 was driven by broad-based demand across the company's product portfolio and end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: As briefly mentioned, revenue from operations for FY26 stood at INR110.7 crores, representing a growth of 32% year-on-year, driven by broad-based demand across our product portfolio and end-user industries.

demand_outlook.claim: The company views the Home and Personal Care segment as a strategically important growth area due to favorable industry dynamics and consumer trends.
demand_outlook.quote: We view HPC as a strategically important growth area, given its favorable industry dynamics, higher value-added product opportunities, and alignment with long-term consumer trends such as premiumization, hygiene awareness, and sustainable ingredients.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's partnership with Lamoral Coatings was commercialized in the last financial year and has gained traction with large corporate customers.
demand_outlook.quote: This partnership, which started in FY24 on trial basis, was commercialized in last financial year and we have got the traction of few large corporate customers in this fiscal.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers are currently in a wait-and-watch mode for procurement as raw material prices cool off.
demand_outlook.quote: April was also fantastic, but now that the prices are cooling off a little bit, we see that customers are in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks, and broadly, they will start procurement again for their next production cycle.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has significant embedded growth potential without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally important, with nearly 47% capacity headroom still available within our existing facility, we possess significant embedded growth potential without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for future capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, our land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for the next phase of expansion whenever business requirements warrant additional capacity creation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: On your second question regarding capex, we will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved to 20.4% in FY26, representing an expansion of over 300 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 20.4%, an expansion of over 300 plus basis points over the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improvement was driven by a combination of favorable product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: The improvement in profitability was driven by a combination of favorable product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage benefits, and continued cost discipline across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs remained broadly aligned with revenue growth due to a stable input cost environment.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material cost remained broadly aligned with the revenue growth, reflecting a relatively stable input cost environment during the year.

margins_costs.claim: The company believes margins of around 35% gross margin, 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and 10% to 12% PAT margin are sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: So yes. As I have said in our pre-IPO meetings, and as I am reiterating today, we believe these margins are sustainable for this kind of product mix and the industries that we currently cater to, around 35% gross margin, around 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and around 10% to 12% PAT margin.

margins_costs.claim: The company's PAT margin reached 10.6% in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, the company produced 11,589 MT with a capacity utilization of 52.7%.
The company's integrated manufacturing facility at Moraiya has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our integrated manufacturing facility located at Moraiya, Ahmedabad, has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization has improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Over the last few years, capacity utilization has steadily improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity utilization was 52.7% in FY26 with actual production of 11,589 MT.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's non-current borrowings were 18.1, 14.3, and 0.7.
Net cash from operating activities was 2.0, 2.5, and -19.1.
Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores in FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to just INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores FY25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized a portion of its IPO proceeds to repay legacy debt.
capital_allocation.quote: This reflects our disciplined approach to capital allocation and our decision to utilize a portion of IPO proceeds towards repayment of legacy debt.

capital_allocation.claim: Short-term borrowings of INR17.1 crores primarily comprise working capital facilities.
capital_allocation.quote: Short-term borrowings stood at INR17.1 crores and primarily comprise of working capital facilities used to support inventory and receivable funding requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term borrowings decreased to Rs 0.7 crores in FY26.
The company's cash flow from operating activities was negative Rs 19.1 crores in FY26.
The company's cash flow from financing activities was Rs 25.7 crores in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's business exhibits seasonality, with approximately 55% of annual revenue generated in the second half of the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is worth noting that our business exhibits a degree of seasonality with approximately 55% of annual revenue typically generated during the second half of the year, and nearly 30% plus during the fourth quarter alone.

risks_headwinds.claim: A higher receivable base is a natural consequence of supporting increased customer activity and sales volume.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, as we continue to grow the business, higher receivable base is a natural consequence of supporting increased customer activity and sales volume.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced some impact last year due to turmoil in Bangladesh.
risks_headwinds.quote: Bangladesh remains a very vital market in the textile chemicals business, and the Bangladesh turmoil, along with the India-Bangladesh relationship, saw some impact last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia crisis led to an immediate rise in raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So there was an immediate price rise, but we maintained a good balance of existing inventory, incoming inventory, and spot market prices, and had good communication with our customers and started implementing the price increase to them.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has one trade receivable item over two years old that is currently pending judgment in the NCLT.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is only one line item which is more than two or two-and-a-half years old, wherein the trade receivable is still on the books because the matter has gone to the NCLT, where the judgment is pending.

management_commitments.quote: On your second question regarding capex, we will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.

management_commitments.quote: Going forward, over the next three years, while we will continue to grow in textiles, the textile contribution should come down to below 50% of the total revenue.
